f.title: Tests read the screen, with independent answers
f.repairRequirement: Add a browser test that opens every REEM page (all 50 menu pages, the 7 tabs, project review, documents, director drawer, portfolio) and compares the displayed text with the answer key. Add three more checks: one fact = one value across pages; banned words; page data size. Expected values come only from source files or consultant sign-off, never from CMeng output (remove actions.openCount 276 as an "expected" value).
f.expectedSourceCheck: All four checks run on the exact release commit and pass before any deploy to the review site.

consultantObservation.evidence: Answer key exists (251 checks) but reads API data only.

f.title: Securities from one rule
f.repairRequirement: Active / expired / expiring is decided once from expiry date vs data date; insurance kept separate from bonds; every page shows that result.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Active bonds 1 (PB 21M); expired 1 (APG 21M, 25 Jul 2026); CAR insurance 210M expired 01 Aug 2026; same on Dashboard, Commercial Overview, Contract page, Director drawer.

consultantObservation.evidence: Contract page: APG expired, CAR policy expired; 21M active on all 9 pages that carry it.

f.title: Schedule counts from one calculation
f.repairRequirement: Critical, near-critical, negative float and delayed-open counts come from one calculation over open execution activities; every schedule page, chart and area table reads it.
f.originalCodeAreas: project-facts.ts; duplicate counts in progress-breakdown, schedule-analysis-core, near-critical-analysis
f.expectedSourceCheck: 41 critical, 7 near-critical, 41 negative float, 192 delayed open; Villa Type B 40 critical; same on every page.

consultantObservation.evidence: Revision History 41 / 7 / 41; Progress Breakdown Villa Type B 40 / 40. Delay pages not re-checked.

f.title: RFI and NCR counts from one register reading
f.repairRequirement: Register pages and the dashboard read the same open / overdue / severity counts.
f.expectedSourceCheck: 53 open / 44 overdue RFIs; 29 major or critical NCRs; same on Dashboard, RFI & Design, Quality.

consultantObservation.evidence: 53 and 29 shown; "Not established" still in 83 row cells on RFI & Design.

f.title: One action register
f.repairRequirement: One record = one action; same total everywhere; RFI / NCR not duplicated as activity actions.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Same action total on Command Center, Accountability, Project review, Portfolio; no record appears twice.

consultantObservation.evidence: 276 on Command Center, Accountability and Portfolio.

f.title: Claims and EOT facts shared
f.repairRequirement: Events, notice timing, determinations and claim days are worked out once and read by every claims page.
f.expectedSourceCheck: 16 events, 0 event dates missing, 14 timely / 2 late notices, 13 d awarded, 75 claimed / 34 assessed on every claims page.

consultantObservation.evidence: Notice Compliance 14 / 2; Delay Event Register "event date missing 0". EOT page still shows "Independent comparison not confirmed".

f.title: Shared inputs and prerequisites
f.repairRequirement: Calendars, quantities, CPM coverage, capacity, installed quantities, discipline list, risk owners and row counts are one shared status, not re-decided per page.
f.expectedSourceCheck: A prerequisite confirmed on one page is confirmed on all; risk register 110 rows; capacity shown for all 12 trades.

f.title: One programme state and a real consistency check
f.repairRequirement: Update02 has one state on every page; the "cross-module consistency" check compares the values actually displayed.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Update02 "current" on every page including Documents; the consistency check fails when any page shows a different value.

f.title: Portfolio uses the same rules for every project
f.repairRequirement: Portfolio cards read each project's shared facts.
f.expectedSourceCheck: REEM 112 card shows extended date 21 Sep 2027 like every other project.

consultantObservation.evidence: Portfolio data: REEM furtherAdjustedCompletion 2027-09-21.

f.title: One page per question, no duplicate blocks
f.repairRequirement: Each topic has one owner page; other pages link to it instead of copying its blocks.
f.expectedSourceCheck: No block appears on two pages; merged pages are tabs of one workspace.

consultantObservation.evidence: 7 pages merged into 3 tabbed workspaces (57 to 50 menu items). Duplicate blocks not re-checked.

f.title: Director drawer and Ask CMeng read the same facts
f.repairRequirement: Both read the shared facts only.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Director drawer figures equal the dashboard; each suggested Ask question gives the answer-key value.

consultantObservation.evidence: Ask not tested (read-only rule: no questions asked).

f.title: Owners from the registers, never hard-coded
f.repairRequirement: Owner = the register's responsible column; if none, the PMC role for that domain. Remove the hard-coded "Not assigned".
f.expectedSourceCheck: NCR-0042 owner MEP Coordinator; NCR-0259 QA/QC Manager; risk owners shown; no "Not assigned" where a name exists.

consultantObservation.evidence: Quality page shows owners (Package Manager, QA/QC Manager); "Not assigned" still 504 times on 30 pages.

f.title: Claims register fully read
f.repairRequirement: Event date, awareness date, responsibility claimed, claimed / assessed days, status and determinations all carried through.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Delay Event Register shows 75 claimed, 34 assessed, status 8 / 6 / 2, EOT 13 d, responsibility per claim.

consultantObservation.evidence: 75 / 34 / 13 and notices 14 / 2 shown; responsibility column not re-checked.

f.title: Procurement register fully read; status drives delivered
f.repairRequirement: Read all 90 packages, long-lead flag, vendor and status. A terminal status (Delivered, Installed, Closed) means delivered even without an actual date. Undelivered packages on finished work go to register clean-up.
f.expectedSourceCheck: 90 packages, 30 long-lead, 68 delivered, 22 not delivered, 17 late; PKG-0056 and PKG-0004 in top actions; suppliers from vendor field.

consultantObservation.evidence: Register read (90, 30 long-lead); PKG-0056 / PKG-0004 in actions; but "44 known late" counts 27 delivered packages (N-1).

f.title: Risk register fully read
f.repairRequirement: Impact, Score, Last Reviewed, Action Due Date and Closed status used.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Scores for 110 rows; 73 open; 37 closed.

consultantObservation.evidence: Risks page: 73 open.

f.title: Resource register actual hours
f.repairRequirement: Actual Approved Usage read by week and linked to the look-ahead.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Actual hours by trade and week; Look-Ahead resources column filled.

consultantObservation.evidence: Actual utilization 30.48% shown; recorded-hours fields still "Unresolved" (41 times on Resources).

f.title: Classify files by header, not file name
f.repairRequirement: Permit register and EVM history recognised as registers and used.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Permit register drives Permits; monthly EVM history drives the cost trend and progress curve.

consultantObservation.evidence: Both files classified correctly in the data; curves on pages not re-checked.

f.title: Bond register instrument column
f.repairRequirement: Instrument column sets the instrument type.
f.expectedSourceCheck: APG recognised as the advance payment security; CAR as insurance.

consultantObservation.evidence: APG-VLC1-0202 shown as Advance Payment; CAR as insurance policy.

f.title: VO and IPC registers
f.repairRequirement: VO status from the register; IPC variations column links VOs to payment.
f.expectedSourceCheck: VO-026 rejected; pending 0; payment linkage 100% (11,776,000 certified by IPC-023).

consultantObservation.evidence: VO-026 rejected, pending 0. Payment linkage not re-checked.

f.title: Commercial terms and dated payments
f.repairRequirement: Advance amount from Sub-Clause 14.2 less recoveries; payment dates make a dated cash series; brief carries cost line; three progress measures side by side.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Advance outstanding 1,396,548; dated cash curve; brief shows CPI 0.96, EAC 218.4M, unpaid 9.9M; EVM 89.1% / certified 87.7% / schedule 88.6% together.

consultantObservation.evidence: Payments shows advance balance 1,396,548. Brief and cash series not re-checked.

f.title: BOQ to programme mapping
f.repairRequirement: BOQ WBS Code maps sections to the 14 WBS areas; physical and certified progress by area.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Mapping 100%; Progress Breakdown physical and certified columns filled; BOQ items linked to packages where the register allows.

consultantObservation.evidence: Mapping 100% in data; Progress Breakdown shows three progress columns. Package link not checked.

f.title: Programme (XER) fields
f.repairRequirement: Baseline dates from the baseline file; discipline from the programme; plot and zone parsed from names; clean filter values.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Baseline start differs from current start where the baseline says so; plot filter (Plot B 42 ...); discipline list matches the programme.

f.title: Programme fallback for empty delivery registers
f.repairRequirement: When no register exists, use programme testing, snagging and handover activities and disruption claims, labelled as programme-based.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Testing, Snag, Handover and Weather pages show the programme activities and claims.

f.title: HSE report fields
f.repairRequirement: Native-text HSE report values extracted.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Man-hours 831,000, LTI 1, LTIFR 1.2, TRIR 1.68.

consultantObservation.evidence: Dashboard shows LTIFR 1.2, TRIR 1.68.

f.title: Clean registers used immediately
f.repairRequirement: Clean rows are used at once with the label "From register". Completeness confirmation only adds percentages; it never hides figures.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Procurement, design, permit and readiness figures shown with no gate; no "confirm complete" banner in front of numbers.

consultantObservation.evidence: Figures now shown; "Confirm these records are complete" still at the top of 5 pages.

f.title: A normal constraint does not block CPM or the forecast
f.repairRequirement: Apply source constraints as P6 does and also run without them; publish both.
f.expectedSourceCheck: CMeng CPM computed for all open activities; P50 / P80 / P90 shown; stage forecast finishes shown.

consultantObservation.evidence: "Independent CPM not established" gone (3,032 hits to 0); P50 +17 d, P80 +46 d, P90 +62 d shown.

f.title: Arithmetic is shown, not withheld
f.repairRequirement: Sums and date additions are shown with their basis: extended date, unpaid, pending VOs, notice proxy, actual hours.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Unpaid 9,899,013; extended date 21 Sep 2027; pending VOs 0; notice days for CLM-003 (44) and CLM-004 (42); actual 755,452 h plotted.

consultantObservation.evidence: Unpaid, extended date, pending 0 and notices shown. Actual-hours point not re-checked.

f.title: Candidate values do not create approval requests
f.repairRequirement: A value read cleanly from the contract or a register is "From source". Approval is raised only when two sources disagree or a user overrides a value. One prompt per fact, not one per page.
f.originalCodeAreas: module-issues.ts line 146; contract term states (LD rate and cap "candidate")
f.expectedSourceCheck: "approval needed" only on real conflicts; LD cap and APG not requested again on the page that shows them.

consultantObservation.evidence: "approval needed" 37 to 104; "Review and promote" 5 to 15.

f.title: Best-available analyses instead of all-or-nothing
f.repairRequirement: Run the feasibility check, recovery scenarios, cash forecast and late-payment test with the data held.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Plaster-chain feasibility shown; recovery scenarios generated; cash forecast from remaining value on the programme; 11 of 21 IPCs paid late.

consultantObservation.evidence: Paid late 11 / on time 10 shown. Cash forecast "No source rows"; crew acceleration candidates 0.

f.title: Every gap has a named route, or it is not an action
f.repairRequirement: Each gap names the missing field, the file and column that would supply it, the owner and one button. Gaps without a route go to a data-gaps list. No re-upload requests for correct files.
f.expectedSourceCheck: No action without a route; unlock steps on the page headline; no "Source productivity forecast" request on management pages.

consultantObservation.evidence: Completeness button now prominent; "Information needed" still 342 times on 29 pages.

f.title: Normal contract structure is not a problem
f.repairRequirement: Two sections with their own dates and damages are normal; do not raise them.
f.expectedSourceCheck: No "section numbers repeat" item in Project review.

f.title: Stale schedule footer
f.repairRequirement: Footer only when a schedule is really awaiting review.
f.expectedSourceCheck: No "newly uploaded schedule needs your review" after adoption.

consultantObservation.evidence: Footer on 0 of 50 pages (was 56 of 57).

f.title: Contract time: extended date everywhere
f.repairRequirement: Extended date = contract + awarded EOT on every page and chart; days late against it; the completion constraint that gives -88 h is named.
f.expectedSourceCheck: 21 Sep 2027 and 15 days late on Dashboard, Brief, Milestones, Completion History, Completion Forecast; contract and extended lines on finish charts.

consultantObservation.evidence: Dashboard and Completion Forecast show 21 Sep 2027 and 15 days; charts not re-checked.

f.title: Sectional completion and delay damages
f.repairRequirement: Section 1 and Section 2 each with date, rate and cap; LD exposure with cap; never a "conflict".
f.expectedSourceCheck: Section 1 35,000/day; Section 2 60,000/day, cap 21M; LD 0.90M (extended) / 1.68M (original) on Dashboard, Contract, Financial Claims; Section 1 to 2 interface.

consultantObservation.evidence: Section table correct on Contract page and Milestones; Contract page shows 1,680,000 / 900,000 but marked "Needs review"; not on Dashboard or Financial Claims.

f.title: Securities and insurance validity
f.repairRequirement: Check cover to completion plus defects period; flag expired insurance.
f.expectedSourceCheck: CAR expired flagged; PB to 31 Dec 2027 flagged as ending 86 days after forecast finish and before the defects period ends.

consultantObservation.evidence: CAR expired with escalation; PB defects-period warning shown.

f.title: Payment rules
f.repairRequirement: Gross vs net; applications are not certified; advance outstanding; 1-riyal rounding is not a failure; due date vs Sub-Clause 14.7; like-for-like ratios.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Gross 196,034,538; net 166,629,358; IPC-024 excluded; advance 1,396,548; rounding passes; due-date basis shown.

consultantObservation.evidence: Payments shows gross, net and advance correctly. Ratio and due-date basis not re-checked.

f.title: Cost rules
f.repairRequirement: Compare EAC with the current contract, not only the original budget; query positive "omissions"; query register value above the contract sum.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Headline: EAC 218.4M is 3.37M below current contract 221.78M; 4 omission VOs queried; 292.5M package value queried.

consultantObservation.evidence: Shows "EAC vs current contract below by 3.37M" but headline still "ADVERSE FORECAST 8.4M above original budget".

f.title: CPM, driving path and programme quality checks
f.repairRequirement: Correct driving chain; stage classification; DCMA-type checks, BEI, CPLI; float erosion rate; criticality definition stated.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Driving chain 34 activities (Plot B42 to B70, MEP, painting, snagging, PC); constraints / lags / relationship checks; BEI and CPLI; "turns critical by" date.

consultantObservation.evidence: BEI present in data.

f.title: Finished work is not open work
f.repairRequirement: Counts and warnings use open work; finished areas are not blocked; RFIs and NCRs on finished work are close-out.
f.expectedSourceCheck: 192 delayed open; no "1,837 awaiting classification"; 44 RFIs and 67 NCRs listed as close-out; finished milestones show no float.

consultantObservation.evidence: RFI and NCR rows marked "Completed linked work"; close-out counts in data.

f.title: Programme change analysis
f.repairRequirement: Completion movement on the comparison page; cause split; update gap flagged; slip rate; driving activities per window; plot filter.
f.expectedSourceCheck: +17 d (Update01 to 02) and +32 d (baseline to 01) stated; logic / lag / duration / constraint split; 427-day gap flagged; slip rate; window driving activities.

consultantObservation.evidence: 427-day gap and 17-day movement in data; pages not re-checked.

f.title: Float trend charts
f.repairRequirement: Unknown values are gaps, never plotted as zero.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Charts show 0 critical at baseline and 41 now.

consultantObservation.evidence: Revision History shows 41 / 7 / 41; chart lines not re-checked.

f.title: Look-ahead blockers
f.repairRequirement: A late long-lead package or open RFI / NCR on a driving activity is a named blocker; float column in the window.
f.expectedSourceCheck: VLC-10-428 shows PKG-0056 as blocker; float and driving flag per activity; NCR-0259 singled out; RFI-0680 / 0677 shown with due date.

consultantObservation.evidence: Quality page lists NCR-0259 as the first required action. Look-Ahead not re-checked.

f.title: Recovery options
f.repairRequirement: State the recovery target and generate the first options a planner tests: second crew, sixth working day.

consultantObservation.evidence: Recovery target shown; "Crew acceleration candidates 0" and "Late procurement packages 44" (N-1).

f.title: EOT pending pipeline
f.repairRequirement: Show the pending claims scenario.
f.expectedSourceCheck: 8 pending, 21 assessed days, scenario date 12 Oct 2027.

consultantObservation.evidence: EOT page: "completion moves to Oct 12, 2027".

f.title: Progress and quantity rules
f.repairRequirement: Progress by area; period and required rate; no cross-item unit sums; query fractional LS; installed value vs certified; earned hours; % installed.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Villa Type B progress shown separately; 132 LS items queried; installed value vs 184.26M certified; earned hours about 752,200 vs 755,452 spent.

consultantObservation.evidence: Per-item curves replace unit sums, but they now load on every management page (N-5).

f.title: Resources against the driving chain
f.repairRequirement: Hours, shortfall and trade for the plaster chain.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Plasterer / mason hours needed vs available for Villa Type B.

f.title: Detailed-claim time bar check
f.repairRequirement: Check Sub-Clause 20.2.4 (42 days) per claim.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Each claim shows days from notice to detailed claim against 42.

f.title: Permits against the programme
f.repairRequirement: Link each expired permit to open or finished work.
f.expectedSourceCheck: 37 expired permits, none on open work, stated.

f.title: Completed-late milestones
f.repairRequirement: List milestones that finished late.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Landscaping +26 d, Villa Type C +9 d listed.

f.title: Portfolio card content
f.repairRequirement: Card leads with forecast vs extended date, days late, cost position, top threat.
f.expectedSourceCheck: REEM card: forecast 06 Oct 2027, extended 21 Sep 2027, 15 days late, CPI, top threat.

consultantObservation.evidence: Data has forecast and extended dates; card text not re-checked.

f.title: Priority by consequence, one action per chain
f.repairRequirement: Rank by driving path, float, milestone and money, then age; one action for a chain.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Top actions: driving chain recovery, PKG-0056, PKG-0004, RFI-0660 / 0680, NCR-0259; not every row HIGH.

consultantObservation.evidence: Top actions: one recovery action for 41 linked activities, then PKG-0056, PKG-0004, RFI-0680.

f.title: Summary pages open with the answer
f.repairRequirement: No activity tables at the top of summary pages; the brief and the director view fit one screen.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Management Brief, Activity Review, Milestones, Near-Critical and Director drawer open with the position, not a table.

consultantObservation.evidence: 500-row "CPM not established" table gone; Management Brief still opens with a 220-row float comparison table.

f.expectedSourceCheck: NCR-0042 "Waterproofing defect" as issue; blockers named (NCR-0259, RFI-0660, RFI-0680).

f.title: Accountability grouped by owner
f.repairRequirement: Group actions by owner with counts and overdue.
f.expectedSourceCheck: One block per owner.

consultantObservation.evidence: Page shows ownership concentrations; grouping not re-checked.

f.title: Documents page shows fields used and ignored
f.repairRequirement: Per file: columns mapped and columns ignored.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Column usage visible for each of the 22 documents.

consultantObservation.evidence: Column usage exists in the data (0 ignored).

f.title: Test projects out of the live portfolio
f.repairRequirement: Separate test projects from real projects.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Portfolio shows real projects only, with a separate test list.

consultantObservation.evidence: 84 test projects still in the portfolio.

f.title: Empty modules load normally
f.repairRequirement: Empty modules return a normal response and one empty-state line.
f.expectedSourceCheck: No HTTP 409 on any page.

consultantObservation.evidence: No HTTP errors or console errors on any of 50 pages.

f.title: Page weight
f.repairRequirement: Server-paged tables; management pages get summaries, not the 896 item curves; each page under 2 MB of data.
f.expectedSourceCheck: Every page data under 2 MB; Activity Review paged.
